reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) is TP: java.util.Random.nextDouble() generates unpredictable-but-not-cryptographically-secure values used for session tokens (line 96), representing a legitimate security weakness per OWASP guidelines. Alert 2 (XSS) is FP: CodeQL traces cookie getValue()/getName() to the sink, but tracing reveals these client inputs only serve as comparison operands in conditional checks (lines 106-111), never flowing into the actual response output—the printed values come from server-side generated rememberMeKey and rememberMe.getName(). Since at least one alert is TP, case label is TP.
